name: Yuri Demon
source:
Feed on the lust of as many girls as you can in this visual novel, where your choices will take you down one path or another, leading to one of the many different endings.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3610630/Yuri_Demon/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这部视觉小说中，尽可能多地满足女孩的欲望，你的选择将带你走一条路或另一条路，导致众多不同的结局之一。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3610630/Yuri_Demon/]Steam[/url]]
